# Scene Flow Datasets

A Large Dataset to Train Convolutional Networks for Disparity, Optical Flow, and Scene Flow Estimation

**2015-12-07 · CVPR 2016 · University of Freiburg and Technical University of Munich**

**[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/1512.02134)** · [Project](https://lmb.informatik.uni-freiburg.de/resources/datasets/SceneFlowDatasets.en.html) · [Data](https://lmb.informatik.uni-freiburg.de/resources/datasets/SceneFlowDatasets.en.html#downloads)

FlyingThings3D, Driving and Monkaa provide synthetic dual-view RGB, dense disparity, scene flow and camera data.
